text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from our outing, as we passed by a park...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh! The children are building a castle.
That's quite a splendid piece of work!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Stay back!
This is our sandbox!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
Damn right!
I won't let anyone slack off!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on.
Why don't you calm down a bit?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Playing together is fine and all.
But kicking someone out just 'cause they're not part of your group isn't right, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Acting all high and mighty!
You can't build a bigger castle than ours anyway!
If you can, maybe I'll listen to what you have to say!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
You want to challenge me... with a castle?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Okay!
I'll take you up on that!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The match began to see who could build the bigger castle within the time limit!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
...Heave-ho.
The base is almost done! How's your side?

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
Looking good over here too!
Let's start dishing it up soon!
choice_data_list: As expected, you look completely used to this.
As expected, you look completely used to this.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, this one's a tough customer!
That just makes it all the more worth challenging!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "How can I pile up the sand while maintaining its structural integrity like they do...?"
choice_data_list: …No.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to get lost in thought, I stopped.
No, that can't be it—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't think!
Just have fun!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Your shoulders are way too tense.
Just enjoy the darts... that's all there is to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Right, no need to overthink things.
No matter the situation or the opponent,
have fun first. That's what matters!”
choice_data_list: Let's have fun building a castle that's just like us!
Let's have fun building a castle that's true to who we are!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Hell yeah, that's what I'm talkin' about!
Let the seas carry us
to glory!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Who cares about theory! Let's build a castle in a way no one else could ever copy!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Alright then, let's get covered in sand right away! We can always just wash our clothes later!
choice_data_list: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha!
Sorry! My hand slipped!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still, now we can fool around as much as we want!
C'mon, c'mon, let's make it huge!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Except! I'm making the top!
I'll make it a design that stands out even from far away!
choice_data_list: I want to make one too!
I want to make one, too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What did you say?
There's no way in hell I'm giving this up!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I'll make it first!! Raaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the two built a sandcastle together, sometimes goofing around and sometimes completely serious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Time was up. Comparing the finished castles, the children's was superior in size.
However...

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Hey. I can see foreign countries out there.
...Never been to one, though.

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
I can see someone dancing in a really flashy way.
...Even though I've never met them before.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you took a liking to our castle!
Pretty exciting, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah……
Our castle is bigger, but……
I'll call it a tie!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You see?
Playing with the others is fun too, isn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: I got to feel like a kid again and had so much fun!
I had fun feeling like a kid again too!
It feels like this is going to be a fun place from now on.
It turned out to be a great design!
It turned out to be a really nice design!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: I got to feel like a kid again and had so much fun!
I had fun feeling like a kid again too!
It feels like this is going to be a fun place from now on.
It turned out to be a great design!
It turned out to be a really nice design!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You really kicked up a racket out there!
It's nice to cut loose like this once in a while, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Man, though... we're both covered in sand.
Doing laundry is gonna be a pain! Ahaha!!
choice_data_list: That's proof we had a blast!
That's proof we had a blast, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! There's no need to play it dainty and polite!
Just steer the helm wherever your heart desires!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Because fun things are even more fun when you share them with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's play again!
Next time, I want all of us to build one big castle together!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! Call me anytime!
I'm always down to make some noise!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
See? Sometimes things work out better
when your head's empty, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Logic is important, but that alone won't make a voyage successful.
In other words—
choice_data_list: Sometimes you just have to follow your heart's compass, right?
Sometimes you have to follow your heart's compass, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!!
Exactly! As expected of my right hand!!
